meta.observed_period: Q1 (1 January), the same cell pop_hist reads
meta.observed_note: `observed` is FOLK1A's measured population in the same seven age groups, 2016–2026. It is the solid half of an age-band chart; the projection is the dashed half. They meet at 2026, which both tables publish, and are never spliced into one series (docs/FORECAST.md §4, §5.6).
meta.join_note: At 2026 the projection's base year and FOLK1A's observed cell are the same population, published twice and rounded twice: they agree to within 1 person(s) over every municipality and age group, which is why an observed line and a projected line meet at that year instead of jumping.
meta.group_gap_note: DST rounds each cell independently, so the age groups re-sum to within 14 persons of the published ALDER=TOT, which is what `total` holds
meta.source: Danmarks Statistik FRKM126 (municipal population projection 2026), national control total FRDK126
